old_caption: The video captures a large bonfire burning brightly in the center of the frame, composed of a pile of logs and branches ablaze with intense orange and yellow flames. The surrounding area is lush with greenery, including tall trees and dense bushes, creating a natural backdrop. To the right, a covered structure with items stored underneath is visible. The sky above is dusky or twilight-colored. The camera shows slight movement, focusing on the bonfire and its immediate surroundings. The flames flicker and dance, casting a warm glow on the nearby logs and branches. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and inviting, suggesting a quiet evening spent outdoors.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene outdoor scene featuring a large bonfire burning brightly in the center of the frame. The fire is composed of a pile of logs and branches, which are ablaze with intense orange and yellow flames. The surrounding area is lush with greenery, including tall trees and dense bushes, creating a natural backdrop for the bonfire. To the right side of the frame, there is a covered structure, possibly a shed or a small pavilion, with various items stored underneath it. The sky above is clear and blue, indicating a sunny day. The camera remains stationary throughout the video, focusing on the bonfire and its immediate surroundings. The flames flicker and dance, casting a warm glow on the nearby logs and branches. The overall atmosphere is peaceful and inviting, suggesting a quiet evening spent outdoors.
caption: The video captures an outdoor bonfire already burning when the excerpt opens, its flame anchored at the top of a cone of long branches and logs. A tall orange-yellow column of fire rises from the pile, its height, width, and lean shifting continuously from frame to frame. At one point the plume broadens and tilts right, forming a puffy flare near its tip before thinning into a narrower stream. A faint trail of smoke drifts upward above the flame's crown, changing shape as it rises. The branches and logs beneath the fire hold their position and shape throughout, with no visible collapse or settling. To the right, a green-roofed open shelter and a stack of cut logs remain fixed, as does a small white jug on the lower left grass. The surrounding trees and pale dusk sky hold their positions, indicating a still camera. The fire persists steadily across the clip, neither growing nor dying out.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
